analysis.problem_hypothesis: Callback and booking enquiries may need manual qualification by repair type, city, urgency, and missing details
analysis.solution: Enquiry-qualification automation for callback and booking enquiries without requiring a new consumer mobile app
analysis.processing: Automated qualification rules engine that filters and categorizes enquiries based on predefined criteria (repair type, city, urgency, missing details) to determine appropriate next steps
analysis.business_value: Reduces manual qualification time, improves enquiry conversion rates, ensures accurate booking and callback routing, and increases operational efficiency without requiring new app development
